svg.aria-label: Gerver's sofa G with its rotation path x(t), drawn in five colours for the five phases [0, φ), [φ, θ), [θ, π/2 − θ], (π/2 − θ, π/2 − φ], (π/2 − φ, π/2]; the path starts at the origin, runs along the top of the niche, and ends at x(π/2) on the x-axis, and dots mark the four phase boundaries
